explanation: Faithfully transcribes the question on erdosproblems.com/1119: for every cardinal ℵ₀ < m < 𝔠, any family of entire functions taking at most m values at each point has cardinality at most m. The value-set and cardinality encodings are correct. As the docstring explains, the statement is independent of ZFC (Kumar–Shelah vs Schilhan–Weinert in models with 𝔠 = ℵ₂), so it can be neither proved nor refuted. The `research solved` tag records that the question has been settled in that sense. This is a modelling caveat rather than a misformalization.
